recommendations: Michael S. Tan “Across two separate disclosures in the past few months, Nickita, founder and security researcher at Peak Security, has reported multiple security vulnerabilities to Rox through our responsible disclosure process. These findings were Critical-severity issues. Our team validated and remediated all of them. In each case he disclosed privately, documented his findings clearly enough to reproduce without unnecessary back-and-forth, and re-tested our fixes to confirm they held. His most recent report drove a permanent improvement to how we validate release artifacts before shipping. His professionalism has been consistent across every interaction, evident in how he discloses, documents, and follows through. I'd recommend Nickita without reservation to any organization that values rigorous security work, whether from researchers or on staff.”

LinkedIn User “It was a delight to have Nickita Khy as an online student in the Inspirit A.I. Scholars program during the winter holiday break from December 2024 to January 2025. During the challenging 10-day program, Nickita successfully completed the advanced curriculum that has ben delivered to 23,000+ students in the past 5 years which covers rigorous A.I. concepts like modern Machine Learning models (CNN, BERT, YOLO, Transformers), Transfer Learning, and intermediate Python. Nickita set a sterling example by participating actively during class: his questions and responses to questions not only clarified points of confusion that no doubt were on some others’ minds, but also encouraged all students to open-up with their own questions and interactions as well, which improved everyone’s learning. Nickita worked well with his teammates and demonstrates the attributes of a natural leader. His strong technical skills and positive attitude will enable him to pursue independent research and to manage the emotional challenges of real-world data science and engineering, data analytics, and model building that will propel his A.I. interests far forward. Nickita’s intellectual curiosity, technical fortitude, and stout perseverance make him a promising contributor in A.I. and other fields that he may pursue in his bright career. I highly recommend Nickita Khy.”
